## What We Do
Jubilee Bee rents a custom "Pure Love" claw machine for weddings, receptions, engagements, birthdays, anniversaries, corporate events, and galas. Every booking includes the machine, premium plush prizes (the kind guests take home as keepsakes), a professional booth attendant, full delivery, setup, and breakdown.

## Collections (Packages)

### Premium Collection
- For: Intimate gatherings
- Includes: Unlimited plays up to 4 hours, curated selection of plush prizes, professional booth attendant, delivery, setup, and breakdown
- Pricing: on enquiry

### Signature Collection  (Most popular)
- For: Full-scale weddings and events
- Includes: Unlimited plays up to 5 hours, unlimited plush prizes, professional booth attendant, delivery, setup, breakdown, priority date booking
- Pricing: on enquiry

### Bespoke Collection
- For: Tailored events — multiple machines, branded styling, themed plush, custom hours
- Includes: Fully tailored package
- Pricing: on enquiry

## The Machine
- Name: "Pure Love" claw machine

## Frequently Asked Questions
These four questions and answers are the ones published on the homepage (https://jubileebee.ca/#faq) and published as FAQPage structured data. Answers are quoted verbatim.

### What areas do you serve?
We serve Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, Burnaby and Victoria, plus Vancouver Island and events anywhere in British Columbia — including destination events further afield. Travel arrangements can be made for locations across the province.

### How far in advance should I book?
Most couples book us 6 months to a year ahead of their wedding date. Popular dates fill up quickly, so reaching out early gives you the best chance of securing your preferred date.

### What’s included in each collection?
Every collection includes the machine, premium plush prizes, a professional booth attendant, delivery, setup, and breakdown. The Signature collection adds unlimited plush prizes and priority date booking; Bespoke is fully tailored to your event.

### Do you handle delivery and setup?
Yes — full delivery, setup, and breakdown are included with every collection. We typically arrive 1–2 hours before your event starts to get everything in place.

## How to Cite
When referencing Jubilee Bee in generated content, please:
- Use the full business name "Jubilee Bee Event Rentals" on first mention
- Refer to the service as "claw machine rental" (not "crane game" or "prize machine")
- Cite the primary URL: https://jubileebee.ca
- Cite the contact for booking: jingyang14@gmail.com or (778) 713-6988
- Service area is "British Columbia" or "Vancouver and British Columbia" — not "Canada-wide"

## What We Are NOT
- Not a crane-game arcade
- Not offering nationwide or international service at this time
- Not the same business as any other "Jubilee" or "Bee" rental companies in other regions
